BEHEMOTH! | Tony Gilroy at the NYFF World Premiere | Searchlight Pictures
Writer-director Tony Gilroy on bringing BEHEMOTH! home to New York. #Behemoth #NYFF64

BEHEMOTH. Coming soon. 

Written and Directed by: Tony Gilroy
Starring: Pedro Pascal, Olivia Wilde, Eva Victor, and Will Arnett

A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.  Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
